Name: Aqualline Drake
Information:
**Aqualline Drake**

The aqualline drake is born from an overlap of the Elemental Plane of Water and the Elemental Plane of Air - it is living water, frozen and solidified by the brisk winds of the Plane of Air. It is a bestial hunter that is capable of communication, but often unwilling to do so. They consider a body of water they occupy to be their territory and will not tolerate visitors within it.

**Feeding**

The drake feeds by freezing living creatures completely solid, and slowly draining their life energy out from the ice, which is trapped within. They will freeze creatures solid then take them back to a lair where they can passively benefit from their life force while in proximity.

**Invisible Swimmer**

The drake’s body is made of crystal clear ice. When outside a body of liquid, it takes on a frosty, bluish appearance, but when submerged it is “wiped clean” and is as clear as glass, allowing light to pass seamlessly through it like clear ice in a glass of water. They are functionally invisible while submerged.

traits.name: Ice Glide
traits.description: The elemental can pass through ice and snow freely, without disturbing the materials as it passes through them, and leaving no marks upon them. It can move through these materials as though swimming.

traits.name: Submerged Invisibility
traits.description: While completely submerged in liquid, its body blends into its surroundings perfectly and is almost completely transparent, and the elemental is treated as though invisible.

traits.name: Underfrost Presence
traits.description: All liquid within 60 feet of the elemental that is not at an unreasonably high temperature is chilled and begins to freeze into slush, and the surface of bodies of water freezes into a 2-inch thick layer of ice. This area is difficult terrain for other creatures unless they can move freely through ice. When creatures within this range attempt to imbibe liquids (like elixirs or potions), there is a 50% chance they will be frozen solid and cannot be consumed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The elemental makes three attacks: one each with its Freezing Jaw, Ice Claw, and Jagged Tendrils.

actions.name: Freezing Jaw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) cold damage.

actions.name: Ice Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Jagged Tendrils
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) cold damage.

actions.name: Gatling Ice Spikes (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The elemental fires spikes of ice from its tendrils that pelt a 60-foot long cone originating from itself, which carry a blisteringly cold wind behind them. Each creature within that cone must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Each creature who fails by 5 points or more is also restrained in place for 1 minute, during which time they can make a DC 16 Athletics check in place of a weapon attack to break free, ending the effect. Taking fire damage or dealing more than 15 damage at a time to the ice (armor class 16) also ends the effect.
